Library

Organ library

Every organ in the experience, isolated. Each tile is one instance of the same component, drawn from the shared point cloud — change the source and every surface that uses it follows.

The ↓ in each visual's top-right corner exports the frame on screen, dot for dot, no smaller than 1920×1920 and inked for whichever theme the page is in — as PNG or SVG on a transparent ground, or JPG with the background baked in.

Organs — Fine Grain

The same organs at exactly twice the particles: each tile draws twice as far into its organ's own cloud, so every added point is a new sample of the same geometry and every render is the same. Slightly smaller dots, the same five sizes, the same opacity grid, the same three inks — a finer stipple, not a denser fill. Each card carries its actual count. This is what the Density switch draws on every other page.

The ↓ in each visual's top-right corner exports the frame on screen, dot for dot, no smaller than 1920×1920 and inked for whichever theme the page is in — as PNG or SVG on a transparent ground, or JPG with the background baked in.

Milestones

The health journey as seven standalone objects, built from the same cloud builder and the same component as the organs — same material, same motion, same scale.
